svg.title: Chess: game 1, move 1
svg.desc: Game 1 of @tannergolden against GitHub, before its first move. It is @tannergolden's turn. White: king e1; queen d1; rooks a1 and h1; bishops c1 and f1; knights b1 and g1; pawns a2, b2, c2, d2, e2, f2, g2 and h2. Black: king e8; queen d8; rooks a8 and h8; bishops c8 and f8; knights b8 and g8; pawns a7, b7, c7, d7, e7, f7, g7 and h7.
